#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

class CODEFORCES {
private:
    istream& is;
    ostream& out;

    void solve() {
        int a, b, l, r;
        is >> a >> b >> l >> r;
        
        StringBuilder sb;
        for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) sb.append((char)('a' + i));
        for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) sb.append((char)('a' + a - 1));
        string base = sb.toString();
        int len = base.length();
        int startIdx = (l - 1) % len;
        string rotated = base.substr(startIdx) + base.substr(0, startIdx);
        int totalLen = min(r - l + 1, 10000);
        set<char> chars;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalLen; i++) {
            chars.insert(rotated[i % len]);
        }
        out << chars.size() << endl;
    }

    void soln() {
        is = cin;
        out = cout;
        long long s = clock();
        solve();
        out.flush();
        // Optional: timing output (disabled for online judges)
        // cerr << (clock() - s) * 1000.0 / CLOCKS_PER_SEC << "ms" << endl;
    }

public:
    CODEFORCES(istream& input = cin, ostream& output = cout) : is(input), out(output) {}

    void run() {
        soln();
    }
};

int main() {
    CODEFORCES().run();
    return 0;
}
